subject: Safe Medford Recommendations for Commission Priorities
overview: The Medford Human Rights Commission welcomed several new members and received a major presentation from Safe Medford outlining recommended roles and operational reforms for the commission. Commissioners discussed the recommendations, focusing on capacity limits, community equity, and updating the commission's enabling ordinance and mission statement.

items.title: Introductions
items.summary: Commissioners, city staff, and community members introduced themselves, including several new and prospective commission members.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the October meeting minutes.

items.title: Updates on Correspondence
items.summary: Frances Nwajei confirmed that commission support letters regarding CCOPS and Question 4 were submitted to the mayor to be forwarded to the City Council.

items.title: Safe Medford Recommendations Presentation
items.summary: Safe Medford presented a proposal identifying four core roles for the commission and twelve operational recommendations, prompting commissioner debate over staff capacity, community outreach, and rewriting the city's enabling ordinance.

items.title: Late Introduction
items.summary: New member Jacqueline Torres introduced herself to the commission.

items.title: Announcements and Next Steps
items.summary: Nwajei instructed commissioners to review past meeting minutes and announced she will distribute copies of past commission brochures to aid in drafting an updated mission statement.
